## Ol' Salt — *My Little Pony: Friendship Is Magic* (G4)

[![Ol' Salt — show still from Hasbro Studios / DHX Media Vancouver](https://vignette3.wikia.nocookie.net/mlp/images/c/c1/Ol%27_Salt_stumbling_ID_S1E21.png/revision/latest?cb=20110405035657)](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/File:Ol%27_Salt_stumbling_ID_S1E21.png)

*Show capture from “Over a Barrel”; production: Hasbro Studios / DHX Media Vancouver.*

Ol' Salt is the elderly Appleloosa earth pony who gets thrown out of the Salt Block saloon during Braeburn's enthusiastic town tour. His dusty brown coat, pale sandy mane, green eyes, pickaxe cutie mark, and disheveled old-prospector look make him recognizable. He's a small comic character, not a secret identity or major plot player. [Character index](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_ponies/Elders).

*Name and speaking status.* His name isn't said in the episode; licensed Enterplay *Premiere* card #48 U identifies him as **“Ol' Salt, Salt Blocked”**—a merchandise-established name, not a spoken introduction. [Card-set listing](https://data.mlpmerch.com/ccg/set/premiere/). He **does speak** in English, pleading for a glass of water after his ejection. Ashleigh Ball is credited with his voice in fan cast documentation; that individual role credit isn't independently established from the episode's end credits. [Episode transcript](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Transcripts/Over_a_Barrel).

*Appearances.* **“Over a Barrel” (S1E21)** is his brief speaking debut; **“Fame and Misfortune” (S7E14)** includes a later background appearance, without a verified new line. Fan artist S.R. Barker also includes him in a [Barkerverse family-tree illustration](https://www.twibooru.org/2804943), which belongs to that artist's fan continuity, not the show's established family history.

## Important moments

Both defining beats happen in the same saloon gag in [the verified official full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=isBwqABm2wI); an exact scene timestamp was not verified.

- *Thrown out of the Salt Block* — **“Over a Barrel” (S1E21):** The barkeep ejects Ol' Salt for having too much salt, establishing the old prospector's comic predicament.
- *“A glass of water?”* — **“Over a Barrel” (S1E21):** His dazed request for water gives him his one memorable spoken line and completes the joke.
